verdict.rationale: Omnara documents a subagents feature that lets an agent spawn, message, monitor and stop helper agents. Agents can also be launched programmatically via the CLI, REST API or TypeScript SDK, which suggests multiple agent tasks can run side by side. However, no evidence explicitly states concurrent execution, concurrency limits, or fleet-level orchestration for throughput. missing for 10: explicit documentation of running many agent tasks in parallel, concurrency limits/scaling guidance, fleet-level monitoring of parallel runs, independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel throughput

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run many agent tasks concurrently to scale delivery throughput

citations.quote: Add a subagents block to an agent's config and it gains tools to spawn helpers, send them messages, read their progress, and stop them.
Launch your first agent with Omnara via the dashboard, or programmatically with the CLI, the REST API, or the TypeScript SDK.
